notes.title: Evil Corporation 10K ... Wishlists
notes.content:
Dear Players across the World,

The last week has been absolutely amazing in many ways; so here's just a quick update:

Thank you so much for already more than 10.000 wishlists, I couldn't imagine to reach so many player for  a DEMO in such a short time. And every single one means a lot to me.

It's my first game to share with a public. wow ... just wow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037721/0ba4850506701027bb24bbc8fe48c302861bac80.png[/img]

can't wait to share more exciting stuff with you. Stay tuned! The release date will be announced soon :)
